text:
marie (Partnerships): 🚀 Quick shoutout — Veridian Insights is live as an ISV listing on Azure Marketplace and we shipped a Dedicated deployment for their QuantSuite product this week. Big win for sales + product. :tada:
raj (Account Executive): awesome!! congrats team. impressive turnaround on the Dedicated pilot.
dana (Product Marketing): can we get a short customer quote + logos? planning a one-pager + social post. would love a before/after metric.
eli (Customer Success): they reported 45ms p95 on inference for 512-token sequences and ~60% unit cost reduction switching to our quantized runtime. customer happy to be in a case study — they agreed to a 30-min recorded interview next Tue.
raj (Account Executive): i'll send over the quote draft and intro to their CPO. also pushing for a co-sell lead with Azure next week.
marketplace-bot: Listing verified by marketplace team — listing id: veridian-quant-suite-2026. Approval TTL: 72h.
marie (Partnerships): next steps: dana, can you draft the one-pager and social draft? eli, secure the recording + 2 screenshots of the console (latency and cost dashboard). raj, I'll handle the PR intro to the Azure field team.
dana (Product Marketing): on it. i'll reuse the quadrant graphic from last case study but will swap in the Veridian metrics. draft by Fri EOD.
eli (Customer Success): scheduled interview for Tue 10am PT, will capture a short quote on implementation time (they went from PoC to Dedicated in 6 weeks).
raj (Account Executive): internal ask — can eng-runtime spot any quick optimizations we used that we should mention publicly? the quantization profile name and the Dedicated SKU would be useful.
marie (Partnerships): tagging eng-runtime in a follow-up thread for technical ack (keeping this thread for comms).
eli (Customer Success): also flagging that the customer requested anonymized throughput graphs for their legal team — will include in case study appendix.
dana (Product Marketing): note for copy: emphasize unified API + predictable pricing for Dedicated customers. avoids a heavy engineering lift for Veridian.
marketplace-bot: Co-sell enablement request submitted to Azure field team (ref: 1797532468).
raj (Account Executive): small celebration in #lunch-plans tomorrow? :beers:
marie (Partnerships): yes please :beers: — thanks everyone, great cross-org effort. will post a polished shoutout once we have the quote and logos.
